Preserve the recognizable game: compact fantasy pixel characters with clean large connected shading clusters, a readable 8x8 diamond battlefield, same steep top-surface diamond aspect 4:3 (not shallow 2:1), approximately same unit-to-tile scale and screenshot composition. All tile grid lines run consistently in just two directions. Visible warm brown thick cut-earth sides. Light from upper left, small contact shadows at feet. Six existing character archetypes from the source screenshot, similar armor and short proportions. Every unit stands clearly on one dry cell. Units and gameplay hazards read before surface detail. Keep the same dark restrained UI layout as the reference, the same text/labels and buttons as closely as possible, recolored using supplied UI roles. SCENE 1 — OPEN GRASSLAND FORD:
Recompose the battlefield into an open grassy crossing. A narrow connected blue-teal stream enters at the upper/back edge, bends diagonally through about 8 cells, and leaves through the front-left edge. Its surface is slightly recessed below grass; exposed banks have brown soil sides. A short TWO-CELL simple wooden bridge crosses it around the center, matching the cell grid; broad wood shapes, no ornate railing. Preserve clearly countable land tiles and plenty of open movement space. Place the six reference fighters in two groups on opposite banks, never in water. One small separate acid puddle occupies a dry cell beside a low metal/stone obstacle; its yellow-green opaque bubbling material must not resemble grass or water. Add one compact orange fire hazard on a dry cell, and one restrained metal spike-trap tile. Two low raised earth tiles at the far bank. Very sparse reeds near 2 bank cells only. Overall open, warm, calm, readable: grass and earth dominate, water second, small acid/fire accents. Keep camera and UI design from reference.

SCENE 2 — FLOODED STONE RUINS:
A distinctly different map and material balance from open grassland: a mostly grey-blue stone courtyard with a stepped surviving elevated path through broken low ruins. Use restrained #5D7078 shadows, #9DADB0 stone/metal planes, muted moss #64785A and a few small warm soil patches #978971. Keep every stone block broad and quiet, cracks sparse. Blue-teal WATER fills a recessed connected corner basin of about 6 cells. A spatially separate ACID spill of about 4 connected cells lies nearer the center-right, pale yellow-green opaque bubbles and a few dark eaten edge marks. There must be dry cells between water and acid. A broken path crosses the map in a staggered L shape; two very low wall remnants and one squat broken column frame the rear without hiding units. One dark missing/void cell with a visible earth/stone cut edge. One fire on a dry floor cell. One very subtle violet magical floor rune using #8E7FA4/#C3B9D2, clearly a small distinct surface effect, no fog or bloom. Six recognizable source characters spread on the dry path/land, feet visible, no one on liquid. Earth/stone sides remain warm brown below the floor. Keep the same steep 4:3 tactical view, game-like modest density and reference UI.
